title: Finite free approximation triangles for finite modules
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $M$ be a finitely presented $R$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Work in the unbounded derived category $D(R)$ of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For every integer $c$, there are a cochain complex $P$ of $R$-modules, integers $a,b$, and a distinguished triangle
$$P\longrightarrow M[0]\longrightarrow C\longrightarrow P[1]$$
in $D(R)$, such that $P^i=0$ when $i<a$ or $i>b$, each $P^i$ is isomorphic to $R^{n_i}$ for some finite $n_i\in\mathbf N$, and $H^i(C)=0$ for every $i>c$. Here the object denoted $P$ in the triangle is the image of the displayed cochain complex under localization at quasi-isomorphisms.

proof.text:
the module in degree zero is pseudo-coherent by the Noetherian cohomology
criterion. Its m-pseudo-coherent approximation is bounded finite free and induces
isomorphisms in all degrees above m. Complete its map to a distinguished triangle.
For i above m, exactness and the two adjacent isomorphisms force degree i cohomology
of its cone to vanish. Choosing m equal to the prescribed cone bound suffices.
Identify each finite free term with a finite power of the ring using a finite basis.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteFree_approximation_triangle
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.FinitePresentation R M] (c : ℤ) :
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
      (T : Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))),
      P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X i ≅ ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R))) ∧
      T ∈ distTriang _ ∧ T.obj₁ = Q.obj P ∧
      T.obj₂ = (singleFunctor _ 0).obj M ∧ T.obj₃.IsLE c
